<document id="disputes-unauthorized">
Disputing a transaction you didn't make
If you see a card transaction you didn't make or authorize, you can dispute it as unauthorized.

## First, protect your card

Before we open an unauthorized dispute, the card used must be frozen or reported lost or stolen. That stops more charges while we investigate. If the card is still in your wallet, freezing is enough.

## How long you have

Report an unauthorized transaction within 60 days of the date of the statement it first appeared on. Statements close on the last calendar day of each month. For example, a transaction that posted in March appears on the March statement, so the window runs from the end of March.

## What happens next

- If your dispute passes an initial review, you get a provisional credit within 10 business days.
- Most investigations finish within 45 days. Foreign transactions, and accounts open less than 30 days, can take up to 90 days.

## Your liability

You aren't responsible for unauthorized card transactions reported within the window.

## Not sure it's unauthorized?

Unfamiliar names are often a merchant's parent company or a payment processor. Tap the transaction to see the merchant's details before you dispute it.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.
</document>
<document id="savings-rate-change-2026">
Savings rate change, June 2026
On June 1, 2026, we changed the rates on Savings Pockets. Here are the old and new rates.

| Plan | Before | From the change |
|---|---|---|
| Basic | 0.75% | 0.50% |
| Plus | 2.50% | 2.00% |
| Premium | 4.10% | 3.75% |

## Why

Our savings rates follow wider interest rates, which came down over the past year. We kept the gap between plans the same.

## What you need to do

Nothing. Your pockets started earning the new rate automatically. Interest earned before the change was calculated at the old rate.

## Notice

We emailed every member at least 30 days before the change.

## Balance cap

The cap didn't change. Plan rates apply up to $100,000.

## Thinking about switching plans?

The rate you earn depends on your plan. Upgrading takes effect immediately, so your pockets start earning the higher rate the same day. Compare plans in the app before you decide.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.
</document>
<document id="disputes-duplicate">
Charged twice for the same thing
Seeing the same charge twice doesn't always mean you were charged twice.

## Check if one is pending

Hotels, gas stations, car rentals and restaurants often place a temporary authorization, then post the final amount separately. The pending one usually drops off within 7 days. Pending transactions can't be disputed.

## If both have posted

If two identical charges have both posted, contact the merchant first. Most will refund a duplicate quickly. If the merchant doesn't help, dispute the second charge in the app as a duplicate. Tap the transaction, then Get help, then Charged twice.

## Duplicate fees

If we charged you the same fee twice, message support. A fee charged in error is always refunded.

## Time limit

Duplicate charges follow the merchant dispute window: 120 days from the transaction date.

## Split payments

Some merchants split one order into several charges, for example when items ship separately. Check your order confirmation before you dispute.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.
</document>
</documents>
